text.title: SDD Promotion Gate Checklist Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable signals to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml; the in-progress → done transition routes to the delegated done gate. Every leaf either applies a concrete rule or routes to `skip-this-methodology`.

decision-tree.root-question: Which gate is the feature at — `in-progress` → `done`, or `backlog/` → `todo/` — and is it ready to move?

conclusion.verdict: delegate — run readiness-checklist; every item ticked with evidence, conditionals verified from the diff
